turns.text: I think there are some, probably the most Famous one is the television tower in the city centre.
turns.zh: 我觉得有一些，可能最有名的是市中心的那座电视塔。

turns.text: It's quite a popular tourist attraction too, actually.
turns.zh: 其实它也是个挺受欢迎的旅游景点。

turns.text: Here's a tip, a final tip: In IELTS Speaking Part 1, you will get some unusual questions.
turns.zh: 给你个建议，最后一个建议：在雅思口语第一部分，你会遇到一些不寻常的问题。

turns.text: You know, "Do you wear a watch?" "Yes." "Why do you wear a watch?"
turns.zh: 你知道吧，比如「你戴手表吗？」「戴。」「你为什么戴手表？」

turns.text: "To tell the time, duh!" But don't say that to the examiner.
turns.zh: 「为了看时间啊，废话！」但别这么跟考官说。

turns.text: Here, "Have you seen any old buildings in your city?" Well, I don't know.
turns.zh: 比如，「你见过你城市里的老建筑吗？」嗯，我不知道。
